questions.q: What was the name of the inn kept by the narrator's father?
choices: The Admiral Benbow
The Royal George
The Spy-glass
The Dead Man's Chest
questions.evidence: my father kept the Admiral Benbow inn

questions.q: What mark did the old seaman have on his face?
choices: A sabre cut across one cheek
A black patch over one eye
A tattoo of an anchor
A burn on his forehead
questions.evidence: the sabre cut across one cheek

questions.q: What did the seaman say people might call him?
choices: Captain
Matey
Black Dog
Old Salt

questions.q: Why did the captain throw gold pieces on the threshold when he arrived?
choices: To pay in advance for his stay
To bribe the father to keep a secret
To show off to the neighbours
To pay the man who pushed his barrow
questions.evidence: You can tell me when I've worked through that

choices: It was described as lonely
It was the cheapest inn
It had the best rum

Fishing from a small boat
Sleeping in his room upstairs
Walking to the village to buy rum
questions.evidence: All day he hung round the cove or upon the cliffs with a brass telescope

choices: He wanted to avoid them
He missed company of his own kind
He hoped to hire a crew
He was waiting for a letter
questions.evidence: at last we began to see he was desirous to avoid them

A blind beggar
A ship flying a black flag
A man with two fingers missing

choices: A silver fourpenny

The narrator sailing away to find treasure
